title: Service blueprint of a support request
source: Illustrative blueprint of a software subscription's support

stages.label: Ask
stages.action: Opens a chat and describes the problem
stages.frontstage: Greets the customer and asks for the account
stages.backstage: Routes the chat by product and language

stages.label: Solve
stages.frontstage: Sends the steps and checks that they worked
stages.backstage: Files a bug when the cause is the product

stages.label: Close
stages.frontstage: Thanks the customer and closes the chat
stages.backstage: Tags the conversation, updates the article
